description: I'm Ray, a final-year BBA student in Finance & Business Analytics at Hult International Business School in Boston. I've interned in the overseas department of a vanadium flow battery company, where I did market research and expansion planning for Saudi Arabia and Australia. I speak English, Spanish and Mandarin, and I'm good at data analysis, framing the business case and building the pitch. I'm recently into AI and the team is only me and other AI tools
